checks.name: R01 scope components and scenario partition without ambiguous concatenation
R02 initialization is awaited; no writes or successful posts before readiness
R03 save persists quantity/header/per-SKU note across independent factory
R03 failed save is rejected with durable data and revision unchanged
R04 intent and original payload persist before dispatch hook and survive interrupted dispatch
R04 prepare storage failure never enters simulated dispatch hook
R05 unknown restore preserves key, input, receipt and posted consumption once
R06 repeated status reads perform zero persistence writes and no extra posting hook
R06 receipt acknowledgement rejects wrong key/record/version without state write
R07 exact replay retains original receipt; changed payload/new unresolved key conflict
R08 independent instances use shared CAS for stale save
R08 simultaneous different-key post of same draft consumes exactly once
R08 simultaneous same-key replay invokes dispatch once and adds one receipt
R09 source originals immutable and forged unit rejected; defensive returned data
R10 corrupt envelope schema stays blocked without silently resetting fixture
R10 non-finite persisted quantity fails initialization without replacement
R10 corrupt persisted document/source relation fails initialization
R10 corrupt operation fingerprint rejected and raw journal preserved
R11 actor/role/warehouse/scenario mismatch never reads another model scope
R12 failed post commit after prepare retains recoverable unknown with zero consumption
R15 mixed/unknown unit groups preserve sums without claiming one unit aggregate
R09 posted/cancelled/pending records remain read-only under save and post
R09 newly saved partial consumes only posted amount and rejects excess remaining
R09 nonpositive/nonfinite/excess quantities never create operation or receipt
R09 duplicate/missing/forged SKU identities and source amounts are rejected
R05 ui draft and source selection survive independent factory without mutation leakage
R11 stale scratch cannot promote rejected edits to current revision after reopen
R11 draft scratch cannot silently borrow current version when caller omits base

limits: Memory persistence is explicit test backing. Independent factories/CAS are local MOCK only; no backend atomicity, live generic DTO, actor authentication or RBAC approval. Canonical stores never opened.
